claims: Monitor arterial blood gas and ventilator parameters closely given respiratory acidosis (pCO2 54, pH 7.37) and mixed spontaneous/controlled ventilation.
Trend hemoglobin and hematocrit (Hgb 8.3-9.9 g/dL, Hct 26-29.2%) and monitor for bleeding or need for transfusion.
Monitor renal function and electrolytes given creatinine 1.9-2.3 mg/dL, BUN 54 mg/dL, and potassium variability (3.5-4.5 mEq/L).
Assess and manage pain with the active multimodal analgesia regimen, reassessing pain scores (currently mild to moderate).
Continue insulin infusion and glucose monitoring per CVICU protocol given fingerstick glucose 90-113 mg/dL and serum glucose 149-174 mg/dL.
Continue propofol sedation infusion and titrate to Richmond-RAS goal of 0, monitoring sedation level.
Monitor hemodynamics including arterial blood pressure, heart rate, cardiac output, and pulmonary artery pressures given labile blood pressure and elevated PA pressures.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor plateau pressures and tidal volumes.
Monitor platelet count (105-145 K/uL) and coagulation profile (INR 1.2-1.4) for trends.
Assess and manage volume status given elevated PA pressures, CVP, and creatinine, with diuretics as indicated.
